game_concept: A action defense set in Mystic Forest – Druid Grove, the druids' grove: the forest ranger must handle mischievous sprites while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Loop Picker: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it.
theme: Mystic Forest – Druid Grove: the druids' grove
core_gameplay_loop: In Druid Grove, repeat each round: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it. Each round, mischievous sprites strike the herb garden, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the picks_right value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the herb garden from mischievous sprites in Druid Grove: keep the picks_right meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 42-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: picks_right drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 42-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 5 (applied tier): Loop Picker
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
